description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the Recent Sequence Ratio (%) on the x-axis and Perplexity on the left y-axis, alongside the GPU Memory Ratio (%) on the right y-axis, for different configurations of the PyramidInfer system. The x-axis ranges from 0 to 100, representing the percentage of recent sequences in the input, and is labeled "Recent Sequence Ratio (%)". The left y-axis, labeled "Perplexity", spans from 4.2 to 4.7, while the right y-axis, labeled "GPU Mem. Ratio (%)", ranges from 40 to 100. The plot includes four distinct lines: "Perplexity" (orange, solid line with circular markers), "Full Cache PPL" (red, dashed line), "GPU Mem. Ratio" (blue, solid line with circular markers), and "Full Cache GPU Mem." (blue, dashed line). The "Perplexity" line shows a sharp decrease from approximately 4.6 to 4.3 as the ratio increases from 0 to 40, followed by a fluctuating trend between 4.3 and 4.4 for the remainder of the range. The "GPU Mem. Ratio" line exhibits a steady increase from about 4.2 to 4.7 as the ratio increases from 0 to 80, then a steep rise to nearly 4.7 at 100. The "Full Cache PPL" line remains constant at approximately 4.4, while the "Full Cache GPU Mem." line stays constant at 100 across the entire range.
